_comment: Coverage ratchet. scripts/check_coverage_budget.py fails when a suite drops
more than tolerance_pts below its baseline.
It is a RATCHET, not a target. Never chase the number: a test written to
move a percentage tests the lines that were cheapest to reach, which are
the lines least likely to be wrong. When coverage rises for a real reason,
raise the baseline in the same commit to lock the gain in.
0.0 is the shipped floor and it is not a placeholder to be filled in on
day one. Until this suite covers source of your own, the only thing being
measured is the scaffold, and --update refuses to record that as yours.
